pull.title: descriptor: Reconstruct a multipath descriptor from its expansion
pull.body:
#36442 allows multipath descriptors to be represented in a single `Descriptor` object. `GetMultipathExpansion` returns the multiple descriptors represented by a multipath descriptor. This expansion is reversible - given the expansion in the order of the multipath elements, it is possible to determine what the original multipath descriptor was. This PR adds `ReconstructMultipath` to produce a new `Descriptor` representing the multipath descriptor that produced the expansion.

Depends on #36442

descriptor: Produce multipath descriptor in ParseScript

Internally, descriptor parsing will produce multipath descriptor objects
rather than std::vector<DescriptorImpl>. This single multipath
descriptor becomes std::vector<Descriptor> within Parse. Future commits
will return the single multipath descriptor object for all descriptor parsing.

events.message:
descriptor: Return multipath descriptor from Parse

Instead of a std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Descriptor>>, Parse can return
a single std::unique_ptr<Descriptor> that contains the multipath
information if the descriptor was multipath. Callers that
require the multipath expansion use GetMultipathExpansion() to get the
expanded descriptors.
